facts.fact: Biju, the volunteer killed at the shelf, was seventeen (Devan says so in the yard).

While reading the crown order, Muthu's thumb stops on one line; he reads it twice and glances at his belt pouch. Neela files it as the hard words (clue C11, matches the round clerk's hand of F808/F504).
Devan, before the yard, gives only the cost (a host three days off, Biju dead) and withholds the cut's place, depth and timing from the crown's rider; Neela notes the omission.
